title: Home
what: What needs you first (Needs you), then all the company's work as a board or a list (?view=board or ?view=list), for everyone or just you. New task with +.

title: Agent
what: One agent: its name, role, job description, instructions and model, Pause or Archive, and the tasks it's on.

title: Company profile
what: What the Chief of Staff knows about the company: overview, mission, goals, people, products, customers, how it works, glossary.

title: Files
what: The company's files with their versions, and the data drive jobs share; each file is Private or Company.

title: Pages
what: The company's pages (live reports on its data), and ideas for new ones.

title: Page
what: One page: the report itself, how fresh its data is, the job that refreshes it, its versions, Private/Company.

title: Research
what: The sources you trust most (websites, X accounts, subreddits, Reddit users), which research looks at first: yours and the company's, with adding, sharing and removing them; and recent research.

title: Settings → General
what: The company's details (name, website), and deleting the company (admins).

title: Settings → Account
what: Your own profile, your WhatsApp link, your working and quiet hours, what your assistant knows about you, your GitHub, and this browser's preferences.

title: Settings → AI
what: The company's own AI provider keys (bring your own key) and the default models for the Chief of Staff and agents (admins change them).

title: Settings → Channels
what: Reaching the Chief of Staff outside Mach1: the company's email address and Mach1's WhatsApp number.

title: Settings → Integrations
what: The company's data sources and website logins: credentials are entered here (never in a chat), plus whose work may use each (every agent can), and testing them.

title: Task
what: One task: its thread (reply, @-mention people and agents, attach files), status, priority, the people and agents on it, a job's parts or the job it's part of, its schedule (Repeats), its files, Private/Company, and Archive, Later and Done.

title: Team
what: Everyone the company works with: people (role, manager, contact details, whether they've joined or been invited, admin or member) and agents (?show=people or ?show=agents). Admins add and invite people here (?new=person opens the form) and remove them.
